# [CS023] Weak RSA Key Size (crypto-weak-rsa)

An RSA key shorter than 2048 bits is generated.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Severity** | HIGH |
| **Category** | Security |
| **CWE** | [CWE-326](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/326.html) |
| **OWASP** | A04:2025 |
| **Auto-Fix supported** | No |

## Why It Matters in Go

Keys below 2048 bits can be factored with practical resources. Go 1.24 refuses keys under 1024 bits by default; use 2048 bits or more, or switch to Ed25519 or ECDSA P-256.

## Vulnerable / Problematic Example

```go
key, err := rsa.GenerateKey(rand.Reader, 1024)
```

## Safe / Idiomatic Go Pattern

```go
key, err := rsa.GenerateKey(rand.Reader, 3072)
```

## Configuration & Suppression

Disable the rule for the whole module in `.codexsentinel.yaml`:

```yaml
rules:
  disabled: [crypto-weak-rsa]
```

Change its severity:

```yaml
rules:
  severity_overrides:
    crypto-weak-rsa: low
```

Suppress one reviewed finding on its line, with the reason:

```go
//codex:ignore crypto-weak-rsa -- <reason>
```

Or ignore it under a path in `.codexsentinel.ignore`:

```text
internal/legacy/** crypto-weak-rsa
```
